summary: Public projects created on 24 July 2026: 9 repos.
intro: Shared 3D character models and a browser game about a race through Jerusalem cover the playful side. Elsewhere there are Linux tools for locking a keyboard, redacting images and monitoring porch noise, plus an ecommerce cart format, a WiFi rules reference and a storage system for renters.

projects.name: 3D Models
projects.description: Shared 3D character models (Corn, Herman) for My Weird Prompts games and projects

projects.name: Esp32 Porch Decibel Monitor
projects.description: Planning repo for a weatherproofed porch sensor documenting a nearby construction site (excavation phase, ~2 months to completion), reporting to Home Assistant.

projects.name: Hands Off

projects.name: Image Sanitiser
projects.description: Detection-assisted image redaction studio for Linux — find QR codes, faces and PII in photos, obfuscate them, and verify they're gone.

projects.name: Israel Wifi Regulations
projects.description: Community reference: WiFi/RLAN spectrum rules in Israel (2.4/5/6 GHz) to help configure APs legally. Unofficial, dated snapshot — official authority is the Ministry of Communications.

projects.name: Race To The Shuk
projects.description: 🫓 Corn the Sloth vs Herman Poppleberry race through Jerusalem dodging giant falafel to grab the last pita in the shuk. Ridiculous 3D browser game.

projects.name: Warehouse Apartment
projects.description: Field manual for a home storage & moving system built on industrial logistics standards (Euroboxes, pallets, picking bins) — born of Israel's tenancy-at-will rental market.
